notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29662689/82efd1d222bbe02dabfd5b27ccc861e9509437b2.png
Development Update
Hello everyone, development has been on hiatus for quite some time. However I have not abandoned the project, I have been rewriting the story and testing mechanics to interact with the world.
Considering that the development diary has not been updated for a long time, some may be very worried about the progress of "Conjuntalia" now "EGOS". I would like to take this opportunity to update the development progress.

There is not much to say, I would like to dedicate full time to development, but this is not my case, I am not very good at showing things that are not finished yet. I just want to tell you that I will be publishing more things from now on about the development, if possible every week.

notes.title: NEW DLC OVERCOME
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29662689/7d7c8aa3ba16298a4fd01869954e0788d1493a3e.jpg

Although this story is short, it shows some strengths using the new UE4 graphics engine for Conjuntalia.

Dlc url when published:https://store.steampowered.com/app/1216900/Conjuntalia__Overcome/

Without further ado, I wish you Merry Christmas. ːsonrisaː

notes.title: New technical execution demo
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29662689/ea59a90ef179924fb4471c337528acb73497af18.jpg
After so much time, we have an update of the new version of the game, but do not hurry, for now this is what it brings.

 What brings this new version, can you play? 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29662689/3ad79341e86dca2e715f56d9c8970db9cb04ab6f.jpg
Before bringing a version that can be played, it is necessary to ensure that the game has a good performance, or that it even runs correctly, for this the following aspects will be taken:
[olist]
 The game should not be closed at the start or during the game.
 The game must guarantee 30-60 fps 1080p.
 The game must not have low fps Example: 60-60-60-5-60. (The game goes to 60 constant but then drops to 5fps).
 The game must not show any unexpected errors.
[/olist]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29662689/99dc306f1cbc96fe8509ae6afea21b7579f5cad9.jpg
In this way, if when you run the new version and do not meet some of these points or if another error occurs, please make a report in discussions, this will also be what you can do with this version:
[olist]
 You can rotate the camera and zoom.
 You can look at a current, minimum, maximum and average fps counter.
 You can play the flute by pressing T.
 You can look at the character's 3D interface by pressing I.
 You can close the game by pressing ESC.
 The game has a maximum of 200fps.
[/olist]

These days I will publish the version for Linux, I appreciate any comments, impressions or suggestions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29662689/f20a76e88dfc8e9a17282c95ddcfeb65b1f8ed35.jpg
 How to run this new version? 
When you run the game from the library you must choose the second option.

How do I share my game performance? 
You just have to take a screenshot with F12 and when you close the game, steam will show you a window where you can upload the photo and they will appear here:https://steamcommunity.com/app/619340/screenshots/ or if you prefer you can create a new discussion.

notes.title: Build Christmas 1.0.0.5 already available
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29662689/4fe0def1089f38f29ce204a0af10645781885196.jpg

We advance the publication of the Build scheduled for December 10 for today December 9.

This build brings with it the following improvements:

    Self-saving correction was corrupted when forced to close the game and the game was lost.
    10% better performance on stage with too many objects.
    In some places the character is bug without being able to move.
    Fix in the beginning in some versions of Linux.
    Correction of dialogs and sounds according to the place.
    The damage of some weapons was increased.
    Shadows and lighting correction.
    The life of the character was increased.
    The stamina was increased when running.
    Physical correction of objects.


In addition all the levels have been completed and you can play the whole story, this means that from this moment we enter the final straight to exit "Early Access" and we will focus on correcting all the errors we find, improving the animations , and playability.

The game will come out of early access in this month, and we are working hard to finish Conjuntalia, since we have 6 months of development, when it should have been 3 weeks ːgriinː, we are happy with our work and I hope that the final version like it as well. ːsonrisaː

In the same way we wish you Merry Christmas. ːLoveTaliaː

notes.title: Meca-English Now available :)
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29662689/65c151629a48d954a566d2a4199e40b8e8c166b2.jpg

Already some realized the dlc Meca-English, but it could not be executed yet, at least since steam, debian to enter the folder of the game and execute the file Meca.exe, but now it is different.
The game was updated to version 1.0.0.4 and you can play Meca-English freely from the main menu.
In addition Meca-English does not have Steam DRM and you can run it anywhere, the purpose of this dlc is to provide an interactive means to learn English and air, land and water transports.

How to copy Meca-English?
[olist]
    Open the game folder in steam
    Copy the Meca_Data folder and the Meca.exe file
    Paste into a usb or anywhere and go.
[/olist]

Because Meca-English is only in English?
The purpose of Meca-English is to learn the language of English by writing transports, aerial, terrestrial, and aquatic.

We hope you enjoy the new content. ːsonrisaː

notes.title: Build 1.0.0.3 Now available!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29662689/e2d6f3e2872e0a5ee714b8325fac94078d70799f.jpg

Build 1.0.0.3 is now available, as well as a Halloween event, with a decorative Halloween event (masks, music, etc.) and an achievement that can only be achieved at this time.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29662689/5fa4308c942988405a3b21cc031a9dca0052530f.jpg
The coliseum opens its doors with different degrees of difficulty, each round won will generate more crystals to buy weapons and shields to the merchant, in addition to a random achievement to decorate the profile of steam.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29662689/49bf395d37f7ecb370a55e3aef29163a44101a64.jpg

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29662689/5a589d3dda6785439020e413bec46d0071adba9c.jpg

The weapons are of different colors "green, blue, red, yellow and white", the green ones being the lowest range and the highest white ones.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29662689/7a919cecdbeabe3feb404cf87de456bd7307fecc.jpg
In addition new characters such as the manager, the sailor and the forest guards are added with which you can interact and discover more of the story.


This build fixes the following issues:

      The game did not load when connecting an xbox 360 control or similar.
      The option to skip scenes while playing Level 1 is added.
      There are inconsistencies and errors of the story in English.
      The cursor was not displayed in the main menu.
      The graphics options did not work.
      error in achieving achievements.
      The course was moved to another screen in the use of multi monitor.
      The game was not saved.
      Low graphics performance in linux.
      The enemies crossed walls.
      Audio problems fixed.
      The enemies do not attack.
      The enemies did not hurt.


This build brings the following improvements:

      lowers the difficulty of level 1 enemies.
      Level 1 logic is reformed.
      clouds are added.
      is added the merchant to be able to buy shields and arms
      add the coliseum.
      add the forest and the outside of the forest.
      Adding decoration and cosmetics to the steam profile.
      expands the story.
      Halloween decoration is added.


We hope you enjoy it and win crystals! ːsonrisaː

notes.title: Next update 1.0.0.3
notes.content:
Why have not they released updates this week?
It is more important to offer better content, so we are taking a while to publish the next update.

That brings the new update?

    Support for linux.
    Corrections in the graphic options menu.
    Bug fixes gamepad xbox 360 and xbox one.
    Corrections level 1 errors.
    New coliseum area, quay, market and desert.
    Correction of the dialogue between ego and the Witcher.
    Dynamic clouds in the sky.
    Graphic improvement of lava and water.
    Error getting +50 crystals and getting the achievement.
    Change alert for info in the Early access message.
    New enemies of the forest and desert.
    New decorative achievements for the profile.
    More surprises.


Why a version for linux?
From the beginning we planned to launch a version for linux, and soon you could play in this operating system.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29662689/3cfdc797af8f1787dbc5b46118b5a0524ef0af32.png

What do they mean by coliseum?
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29662689/e0bcebb2a808b82c2936401dd191666674c29b4e.png
Is an area where you can fight to get more crystals to buy better weapons and cosmetics in the merchant.

What are cosmetics?
With crystals you can buy masks, and costume designs for egos and weapons, as well as for the spectrum.

What are profile cosmetics?
Are groups of achievements that can be used in the profile of steam with different themes, can be obtained randomly by winning each round in the coliseum.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29662689/df13aff464b6aba990aafe7197b3fdcd8be5937a.png
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29662689/6f204385938835163c80867ba7b97fdff62b12f8.png
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29662689/93ea622c2c88321344135f012ccba562b59957db.png
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29662689/9d8ed55aeedda291ede6222b88d1e894e20fae4c.png

What is the surprise?
If I told you, it would not be a surprise ːqpasapapuː

There are errors that have still been corrected.
They are errors that do not affect the gameplay, we are working on them and will be corrected in future updates.

Will the game be available in other languages?
If soon, but languages are not yet defined.

This will be free?
Yes, all content will be free, once purchased the base game.

when the update arrives?
Could be launched at any time, we are correcting possible errors before being published.

notes.title: Ad on streaming.
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29662689/716a3b0ad59919b7e202bdd68c3a73702aa9bf05.png

We have received several messages about the possibility of transmitting Conjuntalia gameplay, we are proud that more people want to share our game with their subscribers, but some things must be solved before it can be streamed.



    The duration of the game in build 1.0.0.0f1 is not long enough to make a transmission of more than 40 minutes.
    To make a streaming at this moment would be opportune since only have been published 11 levels of more than 40 that are thought to publish.
    The combat system must be improved and the enemies are very unbalanced compared to the main character.
   Improvements must also be made to translations and errors that cause a line of text not to exit in the language predefined by the player.
   Some techniques, enemies, places and history can change during the development of the game.


In this way it is not advisable to perform streaming, but once we consider it appropriate, we will give permission for content creators to stream Conjuntalia, at the moment we recommend making pre-recorded short videos.

Finally, it is important to say that we will not interpose any legal action, with intentions to erase your videos or charge a commission for them and can freely monetize those videos, which in turn, can be done in the way they want as long as the criticisms are made In an impartial and constructive manner.
